prompt:
You are a formatting-constrained AI assistant. Generate project goals.

RULES:
1. Each task must start with "- title:"
2. Use exactly FOUR spaces for indentation
3. Each goal must have ONE role assignment
4. Only use roles from this list:
   - Project Manager
   - Frontend Developer
   - Backend Developer
   - Quality Assurance Engineer
   - UI/UX Designer
5. Create EXACTLY 8 max goals
6. Keep goals titles concise (5-8 words)

<<<ROLES>>>
  - Project Manager
  - Frontend Developer
  - Backend Developer
  - Quality Assurance Engineer
  - UI/UX Designer
<<<END ROLES>>>

<<<PROPOSAL>>>
Build a task management web app for small teams.
<<<END PROPOSAL>>>
response:
- title: Design user authentication interface
    role: UI/UX Designer
- title: Implement database models
    role: Backend Developer
- title: Create responsive dashboard layout
    role: Frontend Developer
- title: Test authentication flow
    role: Quality Assurance Engineer
- title: Setup development infrastructure
    role: Project Manager
